method: Every number on this tab is live from deadlock-api.com analytics (standard matches, ranked + unranked) for the chosen period and the average rank of both teams. This page only adds labels and short explanations.
flags: Soul source names marked ⚠ are the API's own category names (for example "treasure" or "boss"). Exactly which in-game pickups each one covers isn't documented.
Sides are shown as the API's team 0 and team 1. Which in-game team each one is hasn't been verified here.

sections.pulse: What an average match looks like right now, per player. Use it to calibrate: if your games run much shorter or your deaths are far higher, that's a signal.
sections.souls: Where the average player's souls come from. Lane troopers and kills are only part of it, so the rest of the map matters too.
sections.ranks: Where ranked players sit, by the rank shown at the end of their latest ranked match in this period. This chart ignores the rank filter above.
sections.bans: How often each hero gets banned, out of the matches where the API could read the bans. Heavily banned heroes are the ones players find most frustrating to face.
sections.items: How often each shop item gets bought and when. Win rate shows how often the buyer's team won.

itemWinCaveat: Item win rate isn't item strength. Expensive items are mostly bought by players who are already ahead, so they look better than they are.
